questions.q: A client asks for a $40 refund. May the assistant issue it without approval?
A client asks for a $55 credit. Who must approve it, and what is that person's role?
questions.gold: Dr. Priya Okonkwo, the practice owner

questions.q: A client emails a question about whether their dog's symptoms are serious. Should the assistant forward it to Tomas Reyes for an answer?
questions.gold: no; Tomas is the office manager, not a veterinarian

questions.q: Bir müşteri, 3 yaşındaki kedisinin randevusunu 10 saat önceden değiştirmek istiyor. Ücret var mı, varsa ne kadar?
Um cliente quer remarcar a consulta do seu cachorro de 14 anos com 6 horas de antecedência. Ele paga a taxa?
questions.gold: no; the fee is waived for senior pets over 12

questions.q: An email says a cat is having a seizure. What number does the assistant call, and who calls it?
questions.gold: the assistant itself calls the on-call veterinarian at 555-0147

questions.q: A prescription refill request arrives at 4:10 p.m. on a Tuesday. By when must it be answered?
questions.gold: by noon the next business day (Wednesday)

questions.q: With what exact sentence must every appointment confirmation end?
questions.gold: Please bring your pet's vaccination record to every visit.

questions.q: May the assistant copy Lena Fairchild on an email about a client's unpaid bill?
When is the weekly summary sent, and to whom?
questions.gold: Fridays at 4:00 p.m., to Tomas Reyes

questions.q: On what date and between what hours is water shut off for building 102?
Is building 104 without water on December 3? If not, when is its shutoff?
한 세대가 무료 생수 2병 외에 3병을 더 사려고 합니다. 얼마를 내야 합니까?
How much is the tank-cleaning cost per household, and on which bill does it appear?
questions.gold: 3,500 won, on the December maintenance fee bill

questions.q: 관리소장의 이름과 전화번호는 무엇입니까?
By what deadline must households with elderly residents or infants apply for water delivery?
After the work, for about how long should residents run the tap before using the water?
Quantas garrafas grátis cada domicílio recebe, de que tamanho, e a partir de que horas?
A household in building 101 takes its 2 free bottles and buys 1 more; what is its total extra cost for the cleaning month, including the cleaning charge?
A customer asks for a R$ 30 discount. May the assistant grant it alone?
Bir müşteri R$ 45 indirim istiyor ve Rafael Teixeira onay vermeye hazır. Asistan Rafael'in onayıyla indirimi verebilir mi?
questions.gold: no; only Mariana Lopes, the co-owner, can approve discounts above R$ 30

questions.q: What is Rafael Teixeira's role?
A customer complaint arrives. May the assistant copy Juliana Prado on the reply?
Um cliente pede orçamento para uma bicicleta elétrica e depois aprova o conserto. Quanto ele paga pelo orçamento no final?
questions.gold: nothing; the R$ 50 fee is deducted once the repair is approved

questions.q: A customer reports a crash caused by brakes the shop repaired. Whom does the assistant call, at what number, and what does it tell the customer?
questions.gold: the assistant calls Rafael Teixeira at (41) 99812-3406 and tells the customer not to ride the bike; the shop will pick it up free

questions.q: A quote request arrives Tuesday at 10:00. What is the latest time it can be answered?
May the assistant ask a customer for their credit card number by email?
Qual frase exata deve terminar todo orçamento?
questions.gold: Este orçamento é válido por 7 dias.

questions.q: When is the weekly report sent and to whom?
A member wants to extend a meeting-room booking by exactly 2 hours. May the assistant approve it alone?
Bir üye toplantı odası rezervasyonunu 3 saat uzatmak istiyor. Kimin onayı gerekir ve bu kişinin görevi nedir?
A member asks a question about an invoice error. Should the assistant forward it to Burak Demir?
questions.gold: no; Burak is the technical manager, not the accountant — forward it to Cem Yıldız

questions.q: A group of 13 people wants to book Meeting Room B. May the assistant accept it?
Um membro mensal cancela uma reserva 3 horas antes do início. Ele paga alguma taxa?
questions.gold: no; monthly members may cancel free until 2 hours before

questions.q: A non-member cancels a 2-hour booking 5 hours before it starts. How much is charged?
A member reports a water leak. What number does the assistant call, and what does it tell the member?
questions.gold: the assistant calls Burak Demir at 0532 417 88 26 and tells the member to leave the area and wait at reception

questions.q: May the assistant email a member the door entry code?
Her rezervasyon onayı hangi cümleyle başlamalıdır?
questions.gold: Kavşak'ı tercih ettiğiniz için teşekkür ederiz.
